patch.summary: GetResponse implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement GetResponse by mapping current email-marketing workflows to GetResponse objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Shopify, Woocommerce, WordPress) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Shopify

blocks.heading: GetResponse day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat GetResponse setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves SMBs wanting email + automation + landing pages in one stack before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Shopify and Woocommerce before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses
Do not expand seats until email campaigns is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Free plan heavily limited after 14-day premium window (branding, LP visits, automation filters)

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: SMS, dedicated IP/domain, and some enterprise tools require Enterprise

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Full contact-band price table beyond headline floors requires plan/list selector on site

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: GetResponse plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

blocks.body: If GetResponse fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.
